utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Oren—I'll let you know what time to come by. We could still use a few more hands on the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday and can help get a few more hands together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you know anyone willing, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I can help with that Saturday porch repair drive. I’ll see if I can round up a couple more helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch and could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d love for you to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help out on the front porch Saturday. Just remind me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the logistics for Saturday’s repair drive on the front porch, so a few extra helpers would really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come, and what do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa — could you come by around 10 a.m.? Even a couple hours would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can come by around 10 and help for a couple of hours.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you know anyone willing, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the front porch repair drive Saturday. Just remind me what time to be there.
